summary: Frontend-only test of the 50-wave campaign (5 acts) on the preview URL at 400x860, using Playwright plus a node simulation of campaign.js over 3000 seeds. PASSED: (1) New run with Mark/Axel/Nathan shows act-intro 'ATTO 1 / 5 · W1–10' and 'Raimon e Tokyo' with the Dove/Chi/Perché cards. act-intro-start opens the map. (2) Map: hub-wave 'W1 / 50', hud-team has 3 portraits with HP bars, hud-traits shows 'Spirito Raimon 3/4 T2', map-act-title and 3 lane names. Only W1 nodes are enabled at start. map-preview and map-enter work. After W1 only the connected W2 node is enabled, the completed node shows a check, and unchosen W1 nodes are labelled 'non scelta'. (3) Rival nodes in act 1 are always at W5–W8 (simulation). The rival W6 battle uses the Royal elite intro (Joseph King). (4) Boss W10: the jump via localStorage works. The boss node is available, boss-intro shows the 3-line dialogue with portraits (next ×2, then start), and the battle runs. consequence-screen 'Accesso al Football Frontier' offers Jude Sharp (Raimon). consequence-recruit adds jude:base and unlocks it. consequence-swap (with jude:royal in team) keeps uid, level 31 and xp 43 in the same slot. Then the reward screen, then the act 2 intro 'Football Frontier', then W11 with all 3 nodes open. (5) W30: two boss nodes. From the hokkaido lane only ghiaccio is enabled and fuoco is disabled. From nara both are enabled. Beating ghiaccio unlocks Gazelle, then the act 4 intro. (6) Anomaly (seed 1, act2:14:0): purple glitch node, preview warning, anomaly-screen with cameo Mark Kruger and picks for Mark and Axel. Accepting starts the battle. Winning shows 'Spirito Guerriero sbloccato: Mark Evans può evocare Gran Majin in partita!' and stores meta.forms mark:keshin. anomaly-leave advances to W15 with connected nodes enabled. (7) Spirit: when locked, 'Gran Majin · da sbloccare in un'anomalia' and disabled. When unlocked, 'Spirito Guerriero: Gran Majin (3 turni)'. The status 'SPIRITO: Gran Majin · 3' counts down 3→2→1, then 'L'energia di Gran Majin si esaurisce. Mark Evans torna normale.' and the button shows 'già usato'. (8) W50: beating All-Stars shows 'CAMPIONI!', journey-log grouped by act and 'Giocatori arrivati in finale'. (9) collection-forms shows 'Spirito Guerriero · Gran Majin (Mark Evans)' plus locked '???' entries, and cards show 'Versione: Raimon'. (10) Two new runs gave different lane sets/orders. No page errors. FAILED/ISSUES: anomaly guarantee broken for ~7% of seeds. On the final W50 win, the journey log says 'Checkpoint non raggiunto' for act 5.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'acts 2-4 guaranteed at least one anomaly' rule is broken. Line 137 skips the anomaly when its (row, lane) hits that lane's rival row (`type !== 'rival'`). Anomaly rows 2-6 overlap rival rows 4-7. Simulation over 3000 seeds: the guaranteed act loses its anomaly in 404 seeds (13.5%), and 207 seeds (6.9%) have NO anomaly in acts 2-4 at all. Example: seed 0 (sure act 2) has no anomaly. Fix: when anomaly.row === rivalRows[anomaly.lane], move the row (e.g. pick from rows 1..rows-2 excluding rivalRows[lane]) or move it to another lane.

At W50, onWin calls finishRun(r, 'win') before completeOverworldNode. The act 5 boss is never added to overworld.journey, so EndScreen's journey-log shows 'Atto 5 · ... Checkpoint non raggiunto' after winning the FFI final. Same for advanceWave when r.wave >= FINAL_WAVE. Fix: finishRun(completeOverworldNode(r), 'win').

anomaly-leave goes through completeOverworldNode, which logs a journey entry of type 'anomaly'. The JourneyLog counts it as 'Rivali e anomalie affrontati' even though it was ignored. Consider tagging skipped anomalies.
The boss/elite/anomaly intro line appears twice in battle-log because the effect's first say() runs before the cancelled check under React.StrictMode double-mount. Dev-only, cosmetic.

issues: The text shows the raw team id: 'Hai già Jude Sharp (royal-academy)'. It should show the display name 'Royal Academy'.
Says '(1 TURNI)' when 1 turn is left. Should be '1 turno'.
Available nodes animate continuously, so Playwright needs force=True ('element is not stable'). This is fine for users. At W1→W2 the 'VOI' marker overlaps the lane header text at the top of the map.

The starter 'add-jude' is already jude:base (Raimon). STORY_LOCKS only affects scouting pools, so a player can start as Jude Raimon from run 1. This contradicts the 'Jude Royal then Jude Raimon via story' progression. In that case the W10 consequence only offers 'continue'. This is a design decision to confirm.

action_items: Fix the anomaly placement collision with rival rows in campaign.js actMap so acts 2-4 really guarantee ≥1 anomaly per run (currently ~7% of seeds have none).
In App.js onWin/advanceWave final-wave branches, call completeOverworldNode before finishRun so the act 5 checkpoint appears as passed in the EndScreen journey log.

Optional: show the team display name instead of primaryTeamId in the Consequence swap hint; fix the '1 TURNI' plural; don't count skipped anomalies as 'affrontati'; decide whether starter Jude should be the Royal version.
critical_code_review_comments: campaign.js:137 anomaly is silently dropped on rival collision. The 'guaranteed' semantics are not enforced. Add a jest test asserting every seed has an anomaly in some act 2-4.
App.js:109 and :96 final-wave paths bypass completeOverworldNode, so overworld.path/journey is incomplete for the last node.

Act 3 always gets both boss nodes: the nara and carovana lanes list both bosses, so any 3 of the 4 lanes include both. The lane choice only matters when coming from hokkaido or osaka, which is acceptable.
Injected hp > maxHp is not clamped by normalizeRun (test artifact only, low risk).
seed_data_creation: None. All state lives in browser localStorage in disposable Playwright sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh browser, so start a new run in every script (new-run-btn, add-mark/add-axel/add-nathan, start-run-btn). To jump: edit inazuma_rogue_run (wave, pending=null, overworld.completedWave=w-1, path, selectedNodeId=null, introSeen=act index, contentSeed=1 for a deterministic map). Seed 1: act1 rivals act1:7:0/act1:6:1/act1:8:2; act2 anomaly act2:14:0; act3 lanes nara/carovana/hokkaido; from act3:29:2 only the ghiaccio boss is reachable. For strong teams set BOTH bonus.{atk,def,hp,spd} and atk/def/maxHp/hp, because level-ups call recalcStats from base+bonus. Map nodes need force=True clicks. A node copy of campaign.js (/tmp/campaign.mjs) is handy for seed simulations.
rca of the issue: Anomaly missing: actMap picks anomaly row 2-6 and lane 0-2 independently of rivalRows (4-7 per lane), and line 137 skips it on collision. Reproduce: node script iterating seeds, check actMap(seed, ACTS[sure-1]).nodes has no type 'anomaly' (e.g. seed 0). Journey: onWin at FINAL_WAVE returns finishRun(r) without completeOverworldNode. Reproduce: jump to W50, beat the allstars boss, and journey-log shows act 5 'Checkpoint non raggiunto'.
